# Support

StillScout is an iOS app for finding post-ready still frames from short video.

## Users (App Store)

- **Help & FAQ:** [Support page](https://somyahangsandesh.github.io/StillScout/legal/support.html)
- **Privacy:** [Privacy Policy](https://somyahangsandesh.github.io/StillScout/legal/privacy.html)
- **Terms:** [Terms of Use](https://somyahangsandesh.github.io/StillScout/legal/terms.html)

For purchase restore, permissions, or account issues, use the contact method on the support page.
